page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: running head at top, one text block of full-width running text with a chapter heading and subtitle, catchword at bottom right. Right page: only its cropped left edge is visible, with no text block to transcribe.

main_text.p: ad generalia Concilia cöuocanda, qua tamen autoritate generalia Concilia nunquam fuerunt conuocata, nec erunt in posterum. Mitto fraudem, artes, stratagemata in eodem Concilio dolo malo peracta: quod quum quosdā sensissent paulo liberiores in dicendo, iuuentā ratio fuit, vt iis reuocatis, atq; summotis, alii summitterentur nequiores: quod maximus Episcoporum numerus esset ex Italia: ꝗ ad extremum eum tum [?], decem & tres Cardinales subito crearentur, Itali omnes, qui ad Concilium missi, suffragiorum numero, atq; auxilio, rem Tridentinam, alioqui ruituram, restituerunt: Quod deniq; veneficiis grassarentur. Nam qui virtute, & sanctitate cæteris præstare videbantur, è medio sublati sunt, inter quos erat Cardinalis Contarenus, qui veneno extinctus est, ne insignis eruditio, & pietas huius viri Scotisticum illud Conciliabulum conturbasse videretur.
main_text.head: CAPUT VII

head.i: Obiectiones, & aduersariorum responsiones ad patrum testimonia, diluuntur.

main_text.p: Hactenus vnam Ecclesiæ vocem per diuersa secula in scripturibus in patribus, ac recentioribus scriptoribus sonantem audiuimus, & in Ecclesia conseruatam, usque ad Concilium Tridentinum. Hæc est illa Ecclesia vera, visibilis, in qua per successiones, vera fides semper eadem tradita est. Pontificia siue Iesuitica ista Ecclesia, quæ hodie fidè hanc oppuguat, nup nata, nouam fidē

page.notes: Right page: only the cropped left edge of the neighbouring page is visible (fragments such as "exhibe", "Rom", "mana", "Alia"). These are the edge of the adjoining page and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "eum tum" after "ad extremum" and "ne insignis" are hard to make out. The word "Iesuitica" is set in a worn form. "oppuguat" appears as printed, a probable printing error for "oppugnat". The word "exhibet" at the foot is a catchword, set at the right below the last line. The chapter heading "CAPUT VII" is spaced out in the print. The sign ꝗ before "ad extremum" is read as "quod" from the context.
